smoking_current.mapping: 1 yes, 2 no; screening no implies not current

drinking_any.mapping: 1 yes, 2 no; at least one drink in previous year

high_cholesterol_history.mapping: 1 yes -> 1; 2 no -> 0; 95 borderline and missing -> null
high_cholesterol_history.meaning: doctor-told high cholesterol before or at baseline; not a measured lipid value

health_worsened.mapping: 1 improved, 2 same -> 0; 3 gradually worsened, 4 suddenly worsened -> 1; other -> null
health_worsened.meaning: health change during 12 months before baseline

weight_gain_10lb.meaning: self-reported gain of at least 10 pounds over preceding 12 months

weight_loss_10lb.meaning: self-reported loss of at least 10 pounds over preceding 12 months

hip_fracture_history.mapping: prior 1 or current 1 -> 1; current 2 -> 0; skipped/unknown otherwise -> null

exercise_regular.mapping: 1 yes, 2 no; regular exercise or sports

preprocessing: fold-local median imputation + missing indicators + standard scaling; bundled with calibrated estimator
temporal_rule: all inputs known at baseline; no followup measurements or outcomes used as predictors
